question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She was ______ when she pointed out the discrimination against women to her manager.
solution:
The correct answer is '**candid**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**candid**" means being honest and straightforward in speech or expression. (स्पष्टवादी)
 
• The sentence implies that she was open and honest when addressing the discrimination issue.
 
• The other options: "**reticent**," "**inhibited**," and "**laconic**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *She was candid__ when she pointed out the discrimination against women to her manager.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Reticent (मितभाषी)**: means being reserved or not revealing one’s thoughts readily.
 
• **Inhibited (संकोची)**: means being restrained or unable to act in a relaxed way.
 
• **Laconic (संक्षिप्त)**: means using very few words, being brief.
